title: Concealment-Exposure
segments: CONCEALMENT OF SIN. the attempt to hide sin from God
Rendered Doubly Certain by God's Infinite Knowledge

; Knowledge 
 
No Matter How Committed, Sin will be Exposed
 
Like the sin of Cain it may be done in secret
Like the sin of Esau, it may be done under the impulse of the moment
Like the sin of Joseph's Brethren, it may be years before its discovery
Like the sin of Achan, it may be well covered up
Like the sin of Samson, it may be done reluctantly
Like the sin of Ahab, it may be prompted by others
Like the sin of Belshazzar it may be done under the influence of strong drink
Like the sin of Herod, it may be the result of a foolish promise
Like the sin of Judas, it may have the approval of the authorities
Like the sin of Pilate, it may be done to gratify the public
Like the sin of the Jews, it may be done in ignorance
